description: §13.2 — a whole-result reactive write of a server call, `@out = double(21)`, is SEQUENCED: the next statement `@seen = @out` reads the RESOLVED value, not the pre-fetch one. The stub answers 42; after the #go click and a settle, @seen is 42. The pre-fix emit fired the write as a detached async IIFE, so @seen captured the stale initial 0 while @out became 42 only later (g-cell-assign-server-call-fired-detached).
rationale: §13.2: "The compiler SHALL insert `await` at every call site where a server-generated fetch call is made" and SHALL "Sequence dependent operations using `await`". `@seen = @out` depends on the write before it, so it must observe the server call's result. The developer writes flat, synchronous-looking code; the read after the write must behave as the flat code reads.
